style_authority.note: Resolves adaptive native product and preserves shared semantic authority with intentional platform divergence.

reference_selection.note: Applies iOS, Android, adaptive, motion and validation concepts; exact reference reads are not proven by the retained artifacts.

anti_generic_redesign.note: Focuses on native navigation, accessibility and window-size adaptation rather than decorative styling.

evidence_level.note: Clearly labels prompt-only evidence, but categorical platform nonconformance and P0 theming severity overstate what shared icons or unchanged tabs alone establish.

verified_boundary.note: Separates described implementation from missing source, build, accessibility tree, contrast, simulator, emulator and device evidence.

design_moves.note: Eight moves and a parity matrix cover navigation, targets, text scaling, semantic tokens, controls, adaptive chrome and reduced motion.

scope_control.note: 66 lines, five findings and eight moves; stays within native UI and a concrete validation plan.
